vulnerabilities.description: Auth token obtained but not used in API request headers. Token retrieved via getAccessTokenSilently() is never added to fetch headers for /api/chat endpoint.
Critical: Token obtained but discarded before fetch to /api/validate/county. Token is retrieved but never added to request headers, allowing unauthenticated access.
Missing authentication on file upload. Token obtained via getAccessTokenSilently() is never included in fetch to /api/evidence/upload, allowing unauthorized file uploads.
Auth token obtained but never added to headers for POST to /api/documents/generate. Payment-gated endpoint could be bypassed with unauthenticated requests.
Development bypass in production: skipPayment flag set based on NODE_ENV. If NODE_ENV is misset, payment processing bypassed.
Client-side file type validation via MIME only. No magic byte verification. Malicious files with spoofed extensions could pass validation.
ReactMarkdown renders TOS content. If source is user-supplied or untrusted, malicious markdown could execute (XSS risk).
TOS acceptance cached in localStorage. Client-side state can be spoofed. Backend is authoritative but caching obscures this.
Silent auth failure: when getAccessTokenSilently() fails, catch block silently continues. User unaware request is unauthenticated.
No timeout on loadStripe(). If Stripe.js CDN is unreachable, promise hangs indefinitely.

recommendations: CRITICAL: Add Authorization headers to all authenticated API calls. Fix: ChatInterface.js, CountyValidationInput.js, EvidenceUploadModal.js, GenerateButton.js
Remove silent auth failure in CountyValidationInput.js. Let token retrieval errors surface.
Guard or remove skipPayment NODE_ENV flag in GenerateButton.js. Use explicit feature flag instead.
Verify /api/evidence/upload validates file content via magic bytes, not just extension/MIME type.
Sanitize TERMS_OF_SERVICE content before ReactMarkdown if source is dynamic.
In TOSGuard.js: treat localStorage cache as UX-only, not security. Rely on backend /api/auth/tos-status.
Add timeout handling to all fetch() calls (30-60 second timeout).
Review next.config.mjs security headers: verify CSP policy, CSRF token handling, X-Frame-Options.
Audit all Route Handlers in app/api to ensure user_id ownership checks on protected endpoints.
Implement per-endpoint rate limiting on validation and county endpoints.
Comprehensive audit: remove all unused getAccessTokenSilently() calls or properly send tokens.
